Two-Unit Investment Opportunity – 8 Bedrooms | 2 Baths | 2-Car Garage

Bring your vision and toolbox to this spacious two-unit property offering 8 total bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. This property needs work and updating, making it a potential opportunity for an investor or buyer looking for a value-add project.

The lower unit features 5 bedrooms, 1 full bath, a large living room, and an eat-in kitchen. The upper unit offers 3 bedrooms, 1 full bath, a large living room, and an eat-in kitchen. Both units provide plenty of space and offer the potential to improve and customize for future rental income or resale.

The property includes basement laundry, one furnace, and two gas hot water heaters, with one hot water heater replaced in 2025. The basement windows have been updated with block windows. Additional features include metal siding, a 2-car garage, and a fenced yard.

This is a project property with significant potential for the right investor or buyer willing to put in the work. With two units, a high bedroom count, garage, and outdoor space, there is plenty of opportunity to renovate, improve, and add value.
